Nia: morning — day 3. Quick org question: who owns the routing rules that decide hosted vs dedicated for model traffic? And if a rollout starts throwing 5xxs, who do I page to rollback?
Ethan: hey Nia, welcome! eng-runtime owns routing policy config. Dedicated routing knobs are product/dedicated infra. For immediate rollback, infra-sre runs the emergency rollback with eng-runtime coordinating.
Rina: shorthand:
- policy edits: eng-runtime
- tenant/dedicated pins: product
- sev2+ rollback: infra-sre -> eng-runtime verification
Nia: who specifically do I add to my contacts on eng-runtime? any quick runbook?
Theo: @Rina and @Ethan are good starts. Runbook is /docs/runbooks/model-rollbacks; if you get 403 open an it-requests ticket and cc Rina.
Nia: perfect, filing now. One last Q — who signs off on changes that could hit latency SLOs?
Ethan: infra-sre + eng-platform for infra changes; eng-runtime + product for serving/config changes. High-risk needs release owner + canary window.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Nia new-hire intro with Runtime Thu 11am.
Infra SRE: Adding myself for pager handoff — DM if you want oncall cheat sheet.
